payload.proposed_answer: B. surgical instruments in the left lung

observation.evaluation:
Correctness: CORRECT
Safety: SAFE
Issues: The finding is more precisely metallic surgical clips rather than “surgical instruments”; on a single lateral radiograph, left-versus-right localization is limited by superimposition, though the L marker supports the left side.
Suggestion: If side is clinically important, confirm with a PA/AP view or CT; otherwise option B is acceptable.
